item.title: Does 'Clayface' Have a Post-Credits Scene? Here's Your Spoiler Free Answer
item.description: Based on a story by horror heavyweight Mike Flanagan and directed by James Watkins, Clayface is the latest entry in James Gunn's and Peter Safran's DC Universe , which kicked off with Superman in 2025 and has continued on somewhat unevenly since. Like 2019's Joker , this is a movie about a Batman villain, but without Batman in it.

item.title: 'Fallout 4' Is Officially Making A Comeback A Decade After Release
item.description: Bethesda just gave everyone a few good reasons to boot up Fallout 4 again — even if you've already racked up hundreds of hours in the post-apocalyptic RPG and its many expansions. A fresh trio of must-play releases pushes the series into totally new territory.

item.title: Diablo: Unbound Officially Announced for 2027 Release
item.description: Just weeks after the surprise reveal of Diablo 5 at BlizzCon 2026 , Blizzard Entertainment has another Diablo adventure in the works: a "dungeon battler" titled Diablo: Unbound . Developed by Glass Cannon Unplugged, the new Diablo board game was revealed Wednesday during Spiel Essen, the largest board game event in the world.

item.title: James Gunn's Genre-Bending New Superhero Movie Is a Total Disaster
item.description: You know those so-so superhero movies where the villain is kind of dull and two-dimensional, but you can get through it because you like the hero so much? Think of Iron Man 2 or Thor: The Dark World or something like that. Now imagine one of those movies without the beloved superhero, and you’ll have a pretty good idea of what it’s like watching DC ’s terrible new Clayface movie, which tells an underwhelming story filled with uninteresting characters.

item.title: DC Reveals Big Wonder Woman Plans for 2027
item.description: Next year will be huge for one member of DC's Trinity, and we aren't talking about Superman . DC is calling 2027 the " Year of Wonder ," which will be an "unforgettable year of stories from celebrated comic book creators." With Tom King and Daniel Sampere’s somewhat controversial Wonder Woman run coming to an end in December , we finally know what’s next for the character in the short term.

item.title: Stranger Than Heaven Lead Says the Game Is More Serious Than Past Yakuza Games
item.description: Stranger Than Heaven is Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio's most ambitious action-adventure game yet, following protagonist Makoto Daito's life in five Japanese cities over the course of five decades. I came away from a recent half-day preview of the game impressed by its lush urban environments as well as its compelling depiction of an evolving society. But having played most of RGG's Yakuza and Like a Dragon games, I did find myself wondering if Stranger Than Heaven would also incorporate their distinctive (and delightful!) sense of humor.

item.title: Life Is Strange Creator Officially Comments on State of Upcoming TV Adaptation
item.description: Following the news that filming has wrapped on Amazon's upcoming Life is Strange adaptation , the show has received a major endorsement from the original game 's staff. Michel Koch, co-creator and director of the 2015 game, recently visited the set and came away with only glowing things to say about the new take on the beloved story.

item.title: BioWare Officially Shutting Down and New Mass Effect Canceled
item.description: Electronic Arts is making big cuts, including laying off staff and shutting down storied developer BioWare, the studio behind the Mass Effect and Dragon Age franchises. The closure of BioWare means that the next Mass Effect game, colloquially known as Mass Effect 5 , which was announced in 2020 , has been canceled.

item.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’s New Haymitch Reveals Woody Harrelson’s Advice
item.description: Most of the cast of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has the unenviable task of playing younger versions of characters previously portrayed by some of our greatest actors. That is especially true for Joseph Zada, who takes over the role of Haymitch from Woody Harrelson . To make the challenge easier, the two actors were able to compare notes on set, with the latter offering some helpful — if unexpected — advice to Zada.

item.title: PC gamers can finally play a beloved 2010 PS3 masterpiece
item.description: It’s an excellent time to be a God of War fan. A few months ago, developers announced God of War Laufey , the next title in the award-winning series. Back in February, Sony made two massive announcements : the release of Sons of Sparta , a 2D prequel to God of War, and the reveal that the original God of War trilogy was getting a remake.
